model_source: Endpoint and model supplied by PolyAI for this benchmark; it speaks OpenAI's Realtime transcription protocol (https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/realtime-transcription)

pricing.billing_basis: submitted audio including silence and retries; rate-dependent estimate, not an invoice

protocol_caveat: Same session, audio, commit and events as OpenAI's Realtime transcription, and the session echoes the requested model. Owl streams a few append-only transcription deltas early in an utterance and then none until the commit, so its partial text can disagree with the completed transcript; the completed item is the transcript.
